QuestInfo.name: Fly in the Sky!
QuestInfo.0: #bMatada#k at the #bCrimson Sky Ferry Site#k knows how to make a monster mount soar through the sky. Perhaps he can teach you this skill!
QuestInfo.1: Matada wants you to gather #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k before he teaches you the #bSoaring#k skill. You can acquire #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k from #bChief Tatamo#k in the town of #bLeafre#k.
QuestInfo.2: Woohoo! You've learned the Soaring skill!

0.0: If you've ever traveled by riding a monster, you know that they get you places quicker than you would've ever thought possible.
0.1: But did you know that some mountable monsters...can fly?
0.2: It's true! If you want one of your mountable monsters to fly, you'll have to learn the Soaring skill.
0.3: All you need to learn that skill is some Ancient Dragon Wing Scales. So how about it? You interested?

yes.0: I knew you would be! So what are you waiting for? Get me the Ancient Dragon Wing Scales!
yes.1: You can get them from Chief Tatamo in the town of Leafre.

no.0: Are you serious?! You really don't want to learn this?

1.0: Do you have the Ancient Dragon Wing Scales?

yes.0: Good, now close your eyes and imagine soaring through the sky on your mount, using the Up arrow and  Jump keys to soar ever higher.
yes.1: Now, you have learned the Soaring skill.
yes.2: Not many mounts know the Soaring skill. Pegasus and Dragon are two creatures that do.
yes.3: Do not forget, you can only stay aloft for a certain amount of time. Press the Jump key often to stay airborne!

item.0: Ah, I see that you do not yet have the Ancient Dragon Wing Scales. You can obtain them from Chief Tatamo in Leafre.
